## Findings
- claim-1: Source-2 states: “\(I_{r,n-r}\) spanned by all \(s_\lambda\) with \(\lambda\not\subseteq(n-r)^r\) forms an ideal” and gives basis \(\{s_\lambda:\lambda\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\). [source-2@L1318-L1330|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: Source-2 states: “\(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) is generated as an ideal of \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) by” \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\). [source-2@L1365-L1375|claim=formal-document]
- claim-3: The inspected bounded source passage defines an ambient box basis and an ideal generating set only; it does not explicitly define a presentation’s columns by \(i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq q^r\), nor state that its complete \(h_1\)-relation rows are all \(h_1s_\lambda\) for corresponding interval-indexed \(\lambda\). [source-2@L1318-L1330|claim=formal-document] [source-2@L1365-L1375|claim=formal-document]
